text_data.128:1134: These legs, this blood, drive me to run.\nWhat I reveal is a lineage of speed. My running is the roar of my blood.
text_data.144:1134: A lovely blossom who runs with wishes and kindness bound together
text_data.163:1134: I'm Curren Bouquetd'or. I enjoy arranging\nflowers beautifully. And also, let's see...\nConflict is... something I may not be very good with.
text_data.164:1134: Making balms, braiding tails and hair
text_data.166:1134: A little floral-scented oil on her ear tips
text_data.167:1134: Tends to move in sync with whoever is nearby
text_data.169:1134: It's always sunny on days out with her mother
text_data.184:1134: Your TP is... full.\nWill you walk with me again today, so we may bloom?
text_data.185:1134: Your RP has built up. Gloriosa, laurel...\nWhat kind of bouquet would you like for the next race?
text_data.469:1134: Self-training is finished. Your next instructions,\nplease, so we may gather a bouquet of glory.
